question: With progressive delicensing of industries as part of liberalisation, which of the following is the industry that is removed from the requirement of license?

options.text: Cigars and cigarettes of tobacco, and manufactured tobacco substitutes

solution:
The correct answer is __**Coal and lignite**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Coal and lignite** have been progressively removed from the requirement of licensing as part of liberalization efforts.
 
• This move is aimed at reducing regulatory bottlenecks and encouraging more investments in the sector.
